verdict.rationale: For agent builders, Stripe documents that embedded mode manages 'the full checkout lifecycle through Stripe, including ... fulfillment', and signals completion to the agent via the `delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed` webhook. That is only a glancing first-party signal that the agent stays in the loop past purchase. Seller-side `checkout.session.completed` events and the checkout session status enum are adjacent and do not show an agent querying an order after the fact. missing for 10: a documented agent-facing API or tool to query post-purchase order status, shipment tracking data (carrier or tracking number), fulfillment status updates delivered to the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
